sloka: प्राप्तं दुःखं महद्घोरं क्लेशं च निरयोपमम् ।अद्य सर्वमहं त्यक्ष्ये निहत्वा रावणं रणे ।। ६.१०१.५१ ।।
transliteration: prāptaṁ duḥkhaṁ mahadghoraṁ kleśaṁ ca nirayopamam ।adya sarvamahaṁ tyakṣye nihatvā rāvaṇaṁ raṇe ।। 6.101.51 ।।

translations.english: '—that sinner has this day come within the range of my sight in battle; and having come within my sight, he cannot live.'
